# Unlock SaaS

> Unlock SaaS is a playbook and toolkit for post-launch, pre-revenue indie SaaS founders. It turns an already-shipped SaaS into a verified paying customer in 60 days, or the founder does not pay. Includes free calculators, SaaS benchmarks, tool comparisons, and case studies.

## Free Tools (interactive, no signup)
- [https://unlocksaas.com/tools/churn-rate-calculator.html](Churn Rate Calculator — Calculate monthly/annual SaaS churn with benchmarks)
- [https://unlocksaas.com/tools/ltv-calculator.html](LTV Calculator — Customer lifetime value from ARPU, margin, and churn)
- [https://unlocksaas.com/tools/saas-pricing-calculator.html](Pricing Calculator — Value-based SaaS pricing recommendation)
- [https://unlocksaas.com/tools/mrr-calculator.html](MRR Projector — Project SaaS revenue growth over 12 months)
- [https://unlocksaas.com/tools/cac-payback-calculator.html](CAC Payback — Months until customer acquisition cost is recovered)
